shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, Brazil's Nubank is in talks with U.K. digital bank Monzo about a potential merger, valuing Monzo at £8 billion to £10 billion, or $10.6 billion to $13.25 billion.

title: Nubank and Monzo Discuss Potential Merger Valuing Monzo at £8B-£10B
